117595.name: Chabad of South Broward
117595.note: COLlive (Illuminations series): Rabbi Raphael and Goldie Tennenhaus began Chabad's work in South Broward in December 1980, first holding services in a small shul on Wiley Street; the first Chabad House in Broward County. Anash: 'Chabad of South Broward celebrates 45 years' (2025). Now 1295 E. Hallandale Beach Blvd.

earlier.where: a small shul on Wiley Street

117590.name: Chabad of Miami
117590.note: Its own site: 'Serving Miami's Jewish Community since 1989', Rabbi Yakov and Gutal Fellig its founders. Chabad.org: co-director of Chabad of South Dade in Miami since 1989. Bet Ovadia, 3713 Main Highway, Coconut Grove. (therebbesimpact.com's 1975 for the couple is not the center's year.)

117903.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Southwest Florida
117903.note: Rabbi Yitzchok Minkowicz 'arrived in Southwest Florida in 1992' (WGCU/press profiles); COLlive: the Minkowiczes asked Rabbi Korf for a place in Florida without shluchim, were sent to Fort Myers and 'opened a small Chabad house in a central location'. Its later building (5620 Winkler Road) was dedicated with $3.5 million (CrownHeights.info).

earlier.where: a small Chabad house in a central location, Fort Myers

4067544.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Tamarac
4067544.note: Tamarac Talk, 22 Aug 2023: the Chabad Jewish Center of Tamarac 'invites the community to celebrate five years since its founding'; Rabbi Kopel Silberberg: it 'started small five years ago'. therebbesimpact.com and the listing number (4067544) also point to 2018.

289988.name: The Rohr Bais Chaya Academy & Synagogue
289988.note: Sun-Sentinel (via CrownHeights.info, 21 Jan 2007): 'Two years ago, the Margate school decided to expand to high school', with a dorm in Coral Springs and a rented space at Temple Sholom, Pompano Beach, for 'the ninth-grade class of 30 girls'; 10th grade added 2006-07; the old bank building at 8100 N. University Drive, Tamarac, bought for $4 million for fall 2007. School listings: first year fall 2005.

earlier.where: rented space at Temple Sholom, Pompano Beach

118265.name: Chaya Aydel Seminary
118265.note: Chinuch Office directory: 'Founded 2002', 1295 East Hallandale Beach Blvd (at Chabad of South Broward). Rabbi Raphael Tennenhaus: the idea came up in September 2001, mourning Chaya Aydel Lebovics, for whom it is named. Jewish Press: entering its 12th year in 2012-13, its 15th in 2016 (both fit 2002). GuideStar's ruling year 2004.

117534.name: Chabad of Plantation
117534.note: Rabbi Mendy and Chanie Posner founded Chabad of Plantation in 1993 in a small storefront of about 800-900 sq ft (COLlive; Chabad.org: 'a small 900-square-foot storefront'); the new 12,000 sq ft building at 10165 Cleary Road: groundbreaking Aug 2008, moved in June 2010 (Sun-Sentinel repost).

earlier.where: a small storefront (about 800-900 sq ft), Plantation

117587.name: Aventura Chabad
117587.note: Founded by Rabbi Casriel and Ziporah Brusowankin in 1970 to serve North Dade (COLlive; Chabad.org: they came to South Florida in 1970 and served North Miami for over 40 years). Its first location was a trailer on the same grounds (Lubavitch.com, groundbreaking for a new building, Dec 2024). Rabbi Laivi and Chani Forta have co-directed for about 25 years. (The city of Aventura dates from 1995; therebbesimpact.com says 1975.)

earlier.where: a trailer on the same grounds

117589.name: Chabad of West Boca Raton
117589.note: West Boca's program guide: Rabbi Zalman and Chani Bukiet moved to Boca Raton in 1989 to establish a Chabad center (with the Denburgs, Central Boca); 'In 1989 Chabad opened centers in Central and West Boca'. Its building was finished in 2016 (Clio).
